posts.text: We picked up over 1,000 pounds of trash in a mile! It’s mindblowing how much trash can stack up along a trail over time. My friend @Nelson Holland has been cleaning it up on his own mile by mile, but it’s become clear to him that that’s a feat that can only be accomplished by more than one person. Some stretches have a -lot- of trash, so we started bringing people together by throwing Colorado Creator Collective cleanups this year to build community and do some good. Exploring a 1,000 year old city in New Mexico 🧭 Well… “City” is a misnomer. Chaco Canyon was less of a permanent residence and more of a gathering place filled with structures for people all over the vast surrounding area to come together and carry out traditions and ceremonies.
